title: Safety Orientation Checklist
description: Free Safety Orientation Checklist template you can edit online and download as PDF. Covers company and site rules, emergency arrangements, hazards and controls for this job.
topics: Hazards And Controls For This Job
html:
REF: ORI-______ REVISION: 01 DATE: ____/____/________

DOCUMENT DETAILS
EMPLOYEE / VISITOR NAME: ________JOB TITLE: ______________
DEPARTMENT: ______________START DATE: ______________
SUPERVISOR: ______________ORIENTATION GIVEN BY: ______________

Company And Site Rules

☐ Health and safety policy and management commitment explained

☐ Site rules, restricted areas, speed limits and housekeeping expectations

☐ Right and duty to stop unsafe work, no-blame reporting

☐ Fitness for work: drugs, alcohol and fatigue rules

Emergency Arrangements

☐ Alarm sounds, evacuation routes and muster points shown

☐ Location of fire extinguishers, first aid kits, eyewash and AED shown

☐ Who to call and how to report an emergency

☐ Shelter / lock-down arrangements explained

Hazards And Controls For This Job

☐ Main hazards of the work area and the controls in place

☐ Permit to work, lock-out / tag-out and isolation rules explained

☐ Manual handling, working at height, confined space, hot work (as applicable)

☐ Safety data sheets and chemical labelling shown

PPE And Equipment

☐ Required PPE issued, fitted and signed for

☐ Training / competence needed before using plant or tools confirmed

Reporting

☐ How to report incidents, near misses and unsafe conditions

☐ First aid and injury reporting procedure

☐ Name of safety representative / HSE contact given

Declaration

1. I have received the orientation above, understood it, and have had the chance to ask

questions.

Approval & Sign-Off

legislation and site procedures.
